problems: e1: edge ↔ wire-end is not a compatible pair
notes: The camera ribbon cable is not in the PARTS list, but the photo shows it joining camera and Pi, so it is added as a new connector type. The Pi's CSI camera connector is not a port in the rpi-4b catalogue entry, so the ribbon's Pi end uses a null port.

In the diagram the black lead goes to the Pi GND pin (physical pin 6, right-hand column) and the orange lead goes to GP17 (physical pin 11). I named these ports GND and GPIO17 as the task instructs, though the catalogue lists GPIO_HEADER, 5V, 3V3 and GND.
On the breadboard the black lead ends at row 3, column a, and the orange lead at row 5, column a. In the catalogue's naming that is 3t.a and 5t.a.

The button sits in the d/e columns, spanning rows 3 and 5. I assumed side 1 is at row 3 (GND) and side 2 is at row 5 (GPIO17). The legs are placed at 3t.d, 3t.e, 5t.d and 5t.e. Pressing the button joins GND to GPIO17, and gpiozero's Button enables the internal pull-up, so no resistor is needed.
For the male-to-female jumper leads, port a is the female end on the Pi header and port b is the male end in the breadboard. This is an assumption.
The software steps (picamzero, Python, ffmpeg) are not part of the physical build graph.
